bundle.text:
# dsh-manim-card bundle patch
#
# 这是插件的挂载声明。`name` 必须写**包名**：用 `dsh plugin add` 装进来时，
# 宿主从 profile 的 node_modules 里解析这个包名，落到它自己的 index.js。
#
# 早先这里写的是 `./plugins/dsh-manim-card/index.js`——那是**开发期软链**的
# 相对路径（profile 目录下的 plugins/<名> 软链到本仓）。软链安装能用，一旦改走
# 正规安装（npm / GitHub 直装），节点_modules 里没有 plugins/ 这一层，
# 启动时就会 failed to import。
#
# 两种装法都用这个文件，不需要各写一份：软链安装时 profile 的 plugins/<名>
# 本身就是一个包（有自己的 package.json），包名解析同样成立。
- insert:
    - id: manim-card
      name: 'dsh-manim-card'

readme.text:
[中文](./README.md) | [English](./README.en.md)

给 DeepSeek Harness 加一个能力：**AI 在聊天里直接写 Manim 代码，当场在聊天流里出现一张可播放的动画卡片**——能播放、能查看代码、能导出视频。

代码在浏览器内执行，运行资源随插件分发，**渲染不需要本机安装 Python**，也不依赖任何外部服务。导出视频有两档：装了就交给本机 Manim 渲 mp4，没装就在浏览器里逐帧导出（见下）。

> 线上文档（安装 / 在聊天里用 / 配置面，中英双语）：<https://snowowowo.github.io/dsh-manim-card/>

- **卡片就长在聊天流里**：一行标题、一块画布，右侧三个按钮——播放 / 查看代码 / 导出视频（点开是两条路）。播放完停在终态画面，不会自己重来。
- **先预检，再呈现**：代码返回前先在真解释器里跑一遍，语法错与不支持的写法当场回给模型、同一回合修正，聊天里不会留下空白或残缺的卡片。
- **渲染不要求本机 Python**：执行在浏览器内完成，运行资源随插件分发。
- **播放有分寸**：只有刚生成的那张卡真播一遍；重新挂载与旧会话里的卡一律直接落终态。手动播放一键压过全部自动规则。
- **导出视频给两条路，谁都能导出**：本机装了 Manim 就交给 manim CLI 真渲成 mp4（1080p）；没装就退到浏览器里逐帧导出（把时间轴按帧出图再编码，webm / mp4 由浏览器定），帧率稳、不实时播。两行的二级菜单各有画质档位：本机默认高清 1080p60，Web 默认流畅 720p30（逐帧编码每提一档就得多等好几倍，想要更清楚的自己往上挑）。菜单里两行各自说明条件，缺什么一目了然；本机环境的逐项探测在插件详情页的配置面里。

在宿主的插件管理里：

```
dsh plugin add github:snowowowo/dsh-manim-card
```

装完刷新宿主页面，「插件」页里出现 Manim Card，它的详情页里有本插件的配置面。首次渲染需要取一次运行资源（约 13 MB），之后离线可用。
在会话里说一句「用 Manim 画一个单位圆」，卡片随即出现在聊天流中。更多细节见文档站的[在聊天里用](https://snowowowo.github.io/dsh-manim-card/guide/usage)。

技术栈、目录结构、开发流程与测试分工见文档站的[开发与调试](https://snowowowo.github.io/dsh-manim-card/dev/)。

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm build      # 产出 client.js
pnpm test       # 单测（不联网那一档）
pnpm docs       # 本地起文档站

本项目依 **MIT** 授权，全文见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)。

随包分发的运行资源与构建产物内联的第三方组件，各依其自身许可——清单见 [THIRD-PARTY.md](https://github.com/snowowowo/dsh-manim-card/blob/main/THIRD-PARTY.md)。

[中文](./README.md) | English

A capability for DeepSeek Harness: **the AI writes Manim code right in the session, and a playable animation card shows up in the chat stream** — play it, read the code, export a video.

The code runs in the browser and its runtime ships with the plugin, so **rendering needs no local Python** and no external service. Video export has two routes: if Manim is installed, your local Manim renders an mp4; if not, the export runs frame by frame in the browser (see below).
> Documentation (installation, using it in a session, configuration surface; Chinese and English): <https://snowowowo.github.io/dsh-manim-card/en/>

- **The card lives in the chat stream**: one title row, one canvas, three buttons on the right — play / view code / export video (which opens two routes). Playback stops on the final frame instead of starting over.
- **Check first, then present**: before the code is handed back, it runs once in a real interpreter. Syntax errors and unsupported constructs go straight back to the model and get fixed in the same turn, so the chat never keeps a blank or half-drawn card.
- **No local Python needed**: execution happens in the browser, and the runtime ships with the plugin.
- **Playback with restraint**: only a freshly generated card actually plays once; remounts and cards from earlier sessions go straight to the final frame. Pressing play yourself overrides every automatic rule.
- **Two export routes, so anyone can export**: with Manim installed, the manim CLI renders a real mp4 (1080p); without it, export falls back to frame-by-frame in the browser (seek the timeline frame by frame, then encode — webm or mp4 depends on the browser), which keeps the frame rate steady and never plays in real time. Each row has a quality submenu: local defaults to HD 1080p60, web defaults to smooth 720p30

In the host's plugin manager:

```
dsh plugin add github:snowowowo/dsh-manim-card
```

Refresh the host page after installing: "Manim Card" appears on the Plugins page, and its detail page carries this plugin's configuration surface. The first render fetches the runtime assets once (about 13 MB); after that it works offline.
Say "draw a unit circle with Manim" in a session, and the card appears in the chat stream. For the details, see [Using it in a session](https://snowowowo.github.io/dsh-manim-card/en/guide/usage).

The stack, directory layout, workflow and test split are documented under [Development](https://snowowowo.github.io/dsh-manim-card/en/dev/).

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm build      # produces client.js
pnpm test       # unit tests (the offline tier)
pnpm docs       # local docs site
